EVALUATE
VAR Base =
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'Period'[Quarter 445],
        'Product'[LT1.4 - Sub-Category],
        FILTER( ALL('Period'[Year 445]), 'Period'[Year 445] = "2026" ),
        FILTER( ALL('Ship From'[Country]), 'Ship From'[Country] = "Colombia" ),
        "Unit Cases", [Unit Cases AC YTD]
    )
VAR Ranked =
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        Base,
        "Rank",
        RANKX(
            FILTER( Base, 'Period'[Quarter 445] = EARLIER('Period'[Quarter 445]) ),
            [Unit Cases],
            ,
            DESC,
            DENSE
        )
    )
VAR TopPerQuarter =
    FILTER( Ranked, [Rank] <= 10 )
RETURN
    SELECTCOLUMNS(
        TopPerQuarter,
        "Quarter", 'Period'[Quarter 445],
        "Product Sub-Category", 'Product'[LT1.4 - Sub-Category],
        "Unit Cases", [Unit Cases]
    )
ORDER BY
    "Quarter" ASC,
    "Unit Cases" DESC
